purpose: Separate matched conditional CJS comparator from the masked/admin-end parity fixture.
model: marked::crm CJS with Phi ~ 1 and p ~ 1, unit intervals, accumulate=FALSE, use.tmb=TRUE, compile=FALSE, hessian=FALSE, itnmax=50
comparison_rule: Evaluate drmTMB and DRModels native likelihoods at these exact marked MLE coefficients and compare the full conditional log likelihood at absolute tolerance 1e-8. Do not remove constants or parameter terms to force equality; record any convention difference.
scope_limit: One small fixed-effects ML comparator only. It is not inference calibration or recovery evidence.
